plain: Your job starts on April 1, 2027.
legal: The Employee's employment shall commence on April 1, 2027.

plain: You'll work 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday.
legal: The Employee shall work forty (40) hours per week, from Monday to Friday.

plain: Your salary is $72,000 a year, paid monthly.
legal: The Employee shall receive an annual salary of $72,000, payable in monthly installments.

plain: You get 25 days of paid vacation a year, plus public holidays.
legal: The Employee shall be entitled to twenty-five (25) days of paid annual leave per year, in addition to public holidays.

plain: You need to ask for vacation at least 2 weeks ahead.
legal: Requests for annual leave shall be submitted not less than two (2) weeks in advance.

plain: The first 3 months are a trial period.
legal: The first three (3) months of employment shall constitute a probationary period.

plain: If you're sick, call your manager before 9 am.
legal: In the event of illness, the Employee shall notify the Employee's manager before 9 am.

plain: You need a doctor's note if you're off sick for more than 3 days.
legal: Any absence due to illness exceeding three (3) days shall be supported by a medical certificate.

plain: You can work from home up to 2 days a week.
legal: The Employee may work remotely for up to two (2) days per week.

plain: You can't take a second job with a competitor while you work here.
legal: During the term of employment, the Employee shall not undertake any employment with a competitor of the Company.

plain: Overtime has to be approved by your manager first.
legal: Overtime shall be subject to the prior approval of the Employee's manager.

plain: You'll get a bonus of up to 15% of your salary based on performance.
legal: The Employee shall be eligible for a performance-based bonus of up to 15% of the Employee's annual salary.

plain: The bonus is at the company's discretion.
legal: The award of any bonus shall be at the sole discretion of the Company.

plain: Either side can end the job with one month's notice after the trial period.
legal: Following the probationary period, either Party may terminate the employment by giving one (1) month's written notice.

plain: The company can fire you immediately for serious misconduct.
legal: The Company may terminate the employment summarily in the event of gross misconduct.

plain: You must follow the company's code of conduct.
legal: The Employee shall comply with the Company's Code of Conduct.

plain: Your company laptop must be returned on your last day.
legal: The Employee shall return the Company laptop on or before the Employee's final day of employment.

plain: For 6 months after you leave, don't try to take our clients.
legal: For a period of six (6) months following termination of employment, the Employee shall not solicit any client of the Company.

plain: Your salary will be reviewed once a year.
legal: The Employee's salary shall be subject to annual review.

plain: A review doesn't mean you'll definitely get a raise.
legal: A salary review shall not oblige the Company to award any increase.

plain: We'll pay for job-related training if you stay for at least a year after.
legal: The Company shall bear the cost of job-related training, provided that the Employee remains in employment for not less than one (1) year thereafter.

plain: If you leave within a year after the training, you'll have to repay half the cost.
legal: Should the Employee resign within one (1) year following completion of the training, the Employee shall repay fifty percent (50%) of the training cost.

plain: You get 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
legal: The Employee shall be entitled to sixteen (16) weeks of paid parental leave.

plain: Please don't use your work email for personal stuff.
legal: The Employee shall not use the Company email account for personal purposes.

plain: Lunch break is 1 hour and is unpaid.
legal: The Employee shall be entitled to an unpaid lunch break of one (1) hour.

plain: The company will contribute 5% of your salary to your pension.
legal: The Company shall contribute an amount equal to 5% of the Employee's salary to the Employee's pension plan.

plain: Your main place of work is our office in Lisbon.
legal: The Employee's principal place of work shall be the Company's office in Lisbon.

plain: We might ask you to travel for work sometimes.
legal: The Employee may be required to travel from time to time in the performance of the Employee's duties.

plain: Work-related travel costs will be paid back with receipts.
legal: Work-related travel expenses shall be reimbursed upon presentation of receipts.

plain: You report to the Head of Engineering.
legal: The Employee shall report to the Head of Engineering.

plain: We can change your duties within reason as the business needs.
legal: The Company may make reasonable changes to the Employee's duties in accordance with the needs of the business.

plain: You need to keep your professional license valid the whole time you work here.
legal: The Employee shall maintain a valid professional license throughout the term of employment.

plain: Harassment of any kind will not be tolerated.
legal: Harassment in any form shall not be tolerated.

plain: If you have a complaint, raise it with HR in writing.
legal: Any grievance shall be submitted in writing to the Human Resources department.

plain: You'll get a written answer to your complaint within 10 working days.
legal: The Company shall provide a written response to any grievance within ten (10) working days.

plain: Shift workers get an extra $3 per hour for night shifts.
legal: Shift workers shall receive a supplement of $3 per hour for night shifts.

plain: You can swap shifts with a coworker if your supervisor agrees.
legal: An Employee may exchange shifts with a colleague subject to the approval of the Employee's supervisor.

plain: You must wear safety boots on the warehouse floor.
legal: Safety footwear shall be worn at all times on the warehouse floor.

plain: Don't come to work under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
legal: The Employee shall not report for work under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

plain: Your employment is conditional on a clean background check.
legal: The offer of employment is conditional upon the satisfactory completion of a background check.

plain: You must give us proof that you're allowed to work here before your start date.
legal: The Employee shall provide evidence of the Employee's right to work prior to the commencement date.

plain: If you resign, you'll be paid for any vacation days you haven't used.
legal: Upon resignation, the Employee shall be paid in lieu of any accrued but untaken annual leave.

plain: You may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days into the next year.
legal: The Employee may carry forward up to five (5) days of unused annual leave into the following year.

plain: The company can put you on paid leave during an investigation.
legal: The Company may place the Employee on paid leave pending the outcome of any investigation.

plain: You will get a company phone, which is for work use only.
legal: The Employee shall be provided with a Company mobile telephone, which shall be used solely for business purposes.

plain: Stock options vest over 4 years, with a 1-year cliff.
legal: The stock options shall vest over a period of four (4) years, subject to a one (1) year cliff.

plain: If you're fired for cause, you lose your unvested options.
legal: In the event of termination for cause, all unvested options shall be forfeited.

plain: You have to give 3 months' notice if you're a manager.
legal: An Employee holding a managerial position shall give three (3) months' notice of resignation.

plain: Interns are paid $20 per hour.
legal: Interns shall be remunerated at a rate of $20 per hour.

plain: The internship lasts 12 weeks and doesn't guarantee a job offer.
legal: The internship shall last for twelve (12) weeks and shall not constitute a guarantee of an offer of employment.

plain: You'll get a written warning before any dismissal for poor performance.
legal: The Employee shall receive a written warning prior to any dismissal on the grounds of poor performance.

plain: You have 7 days to appeal a disciplinary decision.
legal: The Employee may appeal any disciplinary decision within seven (7) days thereof.

plain: Your personal data will be handled under our employee privacy notice.
legal: The Employee's personal data shall be processed in accordance with the Company's employee privacy notice.

plain: Volunteers aren't employees and won't be paid.
legal: Volunteers shall not be considered employees and shall receive no remuneration.

plain: Commission is paid only on deals that close while you're employed.
legal: Commission shall be payable only in respect of transactions concluded during the term of the Employee's employment.

plain: You may take up to 3 days of paid leave if a close family member dies.
legal: The Employee shall be entitled to up to three (3) days of paid bereavement leave upon the death of a close family member.

plain: Jury duty leave is paid in full.
legal: Leave taken for jury service shall be paid in full.

plain: This offer expires if not accepted by May 15.
legal: This offer shall lapse if not accepted by May 15.

plain: The company may change this handbook with 30 days' notice to employees.
legal: The Company may amend this Handbook upon giving thirty (30) days' notice to employees.

plain: Everyone has to complete safety training within their first week.
legal: All employees shall complete safety training within their first (1st) week of employment.
